# OneWill

> OneWill lets users observe, control, handoff, and retcon agent actions through a gaming-inspired overlay for regular coding agents.

OneWill applies database-inspired reliability ideas to AI agent execution. It interposes agent actions so that before an action runs, it must either be reversible or explicitly approved by the user.

Core idea: improve agent controllability by modifying the world around the agent, not by requiring source code changes or agent modifications. Use the same native coding agent; launch through OneWill to get action streams, autosaves, rewinds, retcons, and handoffs.

## Product Summary

OneWill helps users run agents against real mutable state with more confidence. It records and controls agent actions, supports recovery through autosaves and rewinds, enables retcons from earlier points in a run, and allows handoff with preserved context.

## Team

OneWill is built by two Carnegie Mellon CS PhDs in ML for databases. The founders met as undergraduates in the CMU Database Group and have worked together since 2018.

## Brand

Use the public brand name **OneWill**. The domain is `onewill.ai`. The product language is "Agent Retcons" and "retcon agent actions."
